variants.headline: Still in view: government cannot pay its debts
variants.sub: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts.

We hold {target} to a critical standard. An inability to meet public debts is a fundamental failure of financial stewardship, and responsibility should not be displaced by an attractive description of the difficulty.

variants.headline: Still in view: public debt meets a payment failure
variants.sub: Government debt in the colony cannot be paid by the administration.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. The colony's government is unable to pay its debts.

We hold {target} to a critical standard. An inability to meet public debts is a fundamental failure of financial stewardship, and responsibility should not be displaced by an attractive description of the difficulty.

variants.headline: Still in view: the colony's government faces default
variants.sub: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. Government debt in the colony cannot be paid by the administration.

We hold {target} to a critical standard. An inability to meet public debts is a fundamental failure of financial stewardship, and responsibility should not be displaced by an attractive description of the difficulty.
